title: 6646: update mindmaps to use new way of rendering
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

**Introduced Layout Algorithm Support for Mindmaps**
1. Integrated multiple layout algorithms including:
- tidy-tree 
- cose-bilkent (default)
- dagre
- elk
- Planned : ipsec-cola

2.Edge Intersection Improvements
- Applied intersection calculations for edges to avoid connecting directly to the center of nodes in tidy-tree.

3.Shape Support Extended
- rectangle and circle fully handled.
- added support for cloud and bang shapes.

4.Visual Baseline Testing
- Added 5 sample mindmap diagrams.
- Rendered with all supported layouts to establish visual test baselines.


5.Testing Coverage
- Added Visual tests to confirm rendering behavior across layouts.

Resolves #6646 

sub issues
#6763 — Add support for tidy-tree layout
#6764 — Support multiple layout algorithms
#6765 — Create baseline example diagrams
#6766 — Add rendering (visual) tests
#6767 — Edge intersection handling for tidy-tree
#6768 — Edge connection logic for top/bottom intersection
#6769 — Support more shapes beyond rect/circle
#6770 — Handle default and max node widths
## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Describe the way your implementation works or what design decisions you made if applicable.
